verified_database_metadata.warn: Failure to see an auth signing table in catalog is NOT evidence of HS256 or proof the project lacks asymmetric keys.

verified_formal_git_source.config_js: assets/js/config.js resolves the same formal Supabase project; do not copy project reference or keys into PR
verified_formal_git_source.cloud_sync_js: assets/js/cloud-sync.js reads erp_states.data full JSONB document with sync version for the logged-in user
verified_formal_git_source.billing_groups_js: assets/js/billing-groups.js printSaved prepares customer print from current local ERP and original document templates, with separate active vs historical cases
verified_formal_git_source.auth_gate_js: assets/js/auth-gate.js front-end sessionAal decodes JWT claims; frontend role view gates do not constitute cryptographic server authority

auth_signing_mode.public_jwks_read_result: Inaccessible through current external web source; no keys returned or stored
auth_signing_mode.required_verification: Verify CURRENT signing key algorithm and key state through authorized Supabase project Dashboard JWT Signing Keys OR obtain valid verified JWT algorithm evidence without copying bearer token; compare with trusted JWKS where asymmetric
auth_signing_mode.jwks_warning: JWKS may publish standby and previously used asymmetric keys, so their presence alone does NOT establish the algorithm of currently issued access tokens
auth_signing_mode.empty_jwks_warning: Missing/inaccessible JWKS alone does NOT prove legacy HS256
auth_signing_mode.supported_official_method: Supabase Auth getClaims() for genuine Supabase-issued access tokens, with authoritative revocation/session and AAL2 policy checks where sensitive
auth_signing_mode.forbidden: Do not publish private keys, JWT secrets, service_role, real bearer tokens, company/project IDs or user identifiers in GitHub reports

Create approved and reversible database design for independent persistent audit and source version changes only after explicit approval; no SECURITY DEFINER shortcut.
Preserve preexisting confirmed bills and original historical print paths and financial calculations, do not bulk mutate legacy docs.
Enforce external note/invoice/other-zone privacy and exact validated A4 PDF bytes to customer.
Latest SYNCED and full restorable safe backup, complete CI and finance/retention/tax/invoice/bank/payroll/commission regressions plus actual desktop/mobile and official logo/seal.
Separate explicit owner permission for any GitHub main merge, Supabase schema/policy change or deployment.
